rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously described prepared substance; sandhi form before following consonant
first member of the compound name śakti-mudrā
fused form of mudrā and iyam naming the seal; internal sandhi noted but token kept whole
predicate stating the designation of the referent

items.question: What specific seal designation is assigned to that prepared substance?
premises: That prepared substance is the referent.
It is identified as a seal.
The seal is specifically named śakti-mudrā.
items.inference: Therefore that prepared substance is designated the śakti-mudrā.
uncertainties: The exact ritual function of śakti-mudrā in this context is not fully specified in the verse alone.
items.plain_english: That is declared to be this śakti-mudrā, the power seal.
